children: On August 26, 2026, the company received notice from NYSE American that it is not in compliance with Sections 1003(a)(ii) and 1003(a)(iii) due to stockholders' equity of $3.7 million and losses over the past five fiscal years. Oragenics must submit a compliance plan by September 25, 2026, aiming to regain compliance by February 25, 2028. The stock will continue trading on NYSE American under the symbol OGEN with a .BC designation.
